query: SELECT FLOOR(cmt.receivable_id / 100000) as range_100k, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(cmt.ticked) as ticked FROM collection_manual_ticks cmt LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = cmt.receivable_id WHERE ar.id IS NULL GROUP BY range_100k ORDER BY range_100k;
